name: bigquery-mcp
description: Query, analyze, and manage Google BigQuery from Claude — with cost guardrails, PII/PHI protection, and audit logging built in.

project_id.title: GCP Project ID
project_id.description: Google Cloud project to query against.

location.title: BigQuery Location
location.description: Dataset location/region, e.g. US, EU, us-central1.

key_file.title: Service Account Key (optional)
key_file.description: Path to a service account JSON key file. Leave empty to use Application Default Credentials (gcloud auth application-default login).

allow_ddl.title: Allow DDL
allow_ddl.description: Permit CREATE/ALTER/DROP TABLE statements. Each call still requires confirm=true.

allow_dml.title: Allow DML
allow_dml.description: Permit INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE statements. Each call still requires confirm=true.
